     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafQcoh
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# QcohOn for the m-chart glued sheaf (DAT-1, stage 1b, assembly)
    10	
    11	The (P2) localization axioms and the quasi-coherence packaging of the glued sheaf
    12	`gluedSheaf k U g` on a chart `V` under the **trivializing-family interface**
    13	(`informal/spec-dat-1.md` decision (D3), in subordinate form): a finite family of basic
    14	opens `D(h i)` (`h : ι → Γ(X, V)`) covering `V`, each contained in a gluing piece
    15	`U (σ i)` (`hP : D(h i) ≤ U (σ i)` — containment, not equality, so that restricted
    16	families serve smaller charts such as the pinned overlap).
    17	
    18	* `exists_gluedRes_eq_gluedQsmul_pow` — **(P2) denominator clearing**: per-piece
    19	  clearing (`IsAffineOpen.exists_res_eq_pow_mul`), finite uniformization of the
    20	  exponent, defect annihilation on the affine double overlaps
    21	  (`IsAffineOpen.exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_res_eq_zero`), regluing in the sheaf, and a
    22	  local comparison through `gluedSubmodule_ext`.
    23	* `exists_gluedQsmul_pow_eq_zero` — **(P2) defect annihilation**: per-piece
    24	  annihilation, finite uniformization, `gluedSubmodule_ext` against `0`.
    25	* `gluedQcohOn` — the assembled packaging `Scheme.QcohOn (gluedSheaf k U g) V`
    26	  (a `def`; keyed `instance`s are declared only at the pinned datum, stage 1d).
    27	-/
    28	
    29	set_option autoImplicit false
    30	
    31	universe u
    32	
    33	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    36	
    37	section Assembly
    38	
    39	variable (k : Type u) [CommRing k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    40	
    41	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule
    42	
    43	variable {J : Type u} (U : J → X.Opens) (g : ∀ i j : J, Γ(X, U i ⊓ U j)ˣ)
    44	variable {V : X.Opens} {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] {σ : ι → J} {h : ι → Γ(X, V)}
    45	
    46	/-- **(P2) denominator clearing for the glued sheaf** on a chart with a trivializing
    47	subordinate basic-open family: a glued section over `V' ⊓ D(q)` extends to `V'` after
    48	scaling by a power of `q`. -/
    49	theorem exists_gluedRes_eq_gluedQsmul_pow (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)
    50	    (hP : ∀ i : ι, X.basicOpen (h i) ≤ U (σ i))
    51	    (hcov : V ≤ ⨆ i : ι, X.basicOpen (h i))
    52	    {V' : X.Opens} (hV' : IsAffineOpen V') (hV'V : V' ≤ V) (q : Γ(X, V))
    53	    (c : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q))) :
    54	    ∃ (N : ℕ) (e : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g V')),
    55	      gluedRes k U g inf_le_left e =
    56	        gluedQsmul k U g ((inf_le_left : V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q ≤ V').trans hV'V)
    57	          (q ^ N) c := by
    58	  classical
    59	  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite ι
    60	  -- the pieces and double overlaps are affine
    61	  have hPaff : ∀ i : ι, IsAffineOpen (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) := by
    62	    intro i
    63	    rw [← Scheme.basicOpen_resHom hV'V (h i)]
    64	    exact hV'.basicOpen _
    65	  have hOaff : ∀ i i' : ι,
    66	      IsAffineOpen (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) := by
    67	    intro i i'
    68	    rw [inf_assoc, ← Scheme.basicOpen_mul, ← Scheme.basicOpen_resHom hV'V]
    69	    exact hV'.basicOpen _
    70	  -- the components of `c`, reshuffled onto the pieces
    71	  have hpc : ∀ i : ι,
    72	      (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ X.basicOpen q ≤
    73	        (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q) ⊓ U (σ i) := fun i =>
    74	    le_inf (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right)
    75	      ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hP i))
    76	  -- per-piece denominator clearing
    77	  have hden : ∀ i : ι, ∃ (N : ℕ) (e : Γ(X, V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i))),
    78	      X.resHom inf_le_left e =
    79	        X.resHom (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_left.trans hV'V)) q ^ N *
    80	          X.resHom (hpc i) (c.val (σ i)) := fun i =>
    81	    (hPaff i).exists_res_eq_pow_mul (inf_le_left.trans hV'V) q
    82	      (X.resHom (hpc i) (c.val (σ i)))
    83	  choose N₁ e₁ he₁ using hden
    84	  set N := Finset.univ.sup N₁ with hNdef
    85	  -- the uniformized clears
    86	  have hden₂ : ∀ i : ι, ∃ e₂ : Γ(X, V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)),
    87	      X.resHom inf_le_left e₂ =
    88	        X.resHom (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_left.trans hV'V)) q ^ N *
    89	          X.resHom (hpc i) (c.val (σ i)) := by
    90	    intro i
    91	    refine ⟨X.resHom (inf_le_left.trans hV'V) q ^ (N - N₁ i) * e₁ i, ?_⟩
    92	    rw [map_mul, map_pow, Scheme.resHom_resHom, he₁ i, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add,
    93	      Nat.sub_add_cancel (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ i))]
    94	  choose E hE using hden₂
    95	  -- defect annihilation on the affine double overlaps
    96	  have hann : ∀ i i' : ι, ∃ M : ℕ,
    97	      X.resHom ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left).trans hV'V) q ^ M *
    98	        (X.resHom (inf_le_left :
    99	            V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i') ≤ V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i))
   100	            (E i) -
   101	          X.resHom (le_inf ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hP i))
   102	                (inf_le_right.trans (hP i')) :
   103	              V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i') ≤ U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))
   104	              (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))) *
   105	            X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right :
   106	              V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i') ≤ V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i'))
   107	              (E i')) = 0 := by
   108	    intro i i'
   109	    refine (hOaff i i').exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_res_eq_zero
   110	      ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left).trans hV'V) q _ ?_
   111	    have k₁ := congrArg (X.resHom (inf_le_inf_right (X.basicOpen q)
   112	      (inf_le_left : V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i') ≤
   113	        V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)))) (hE i)
   114	    have k₂ := congrArg (X.resHom (inf_le_inf_right (X.basicOpen q)
   115	      (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right :
   116	        V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i') ≤
   117	          V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')))) (hE i')
   118	    have k₃ := congrArg
   119	      (X.resHom (le_inf (le_inf (le_inf
   120	          (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)) inf_le_right)
   121	          ((inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right)).trans (hP i)))
   122	          ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hP i')) :
   123	        (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) ⊓ X.basicOpen q ≤
   124	          (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q) ⊓ U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i')))
   125	      ((mem_gluedSubmodule_iff k U g
   126	        (c.val : ∀ l : J, Γ(X, (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q) ⊓ U l))).mp
   127	        c.property (σ i) (σ i'))
   128	    rw [map_mul, map_pow] at k₁ k₂
   129	    rw [map_mul] at k₃
   130	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at k₁ k₂ k₃
   131	    rw [map_sub, map_mul]
   132	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   133	    rw [k₁, k₂, k₃]
   134	    ring
   135	  choose M₁ hM₁ using hann
   136	  set M := Finset.univ.sup fun i => Finset.univ.sup (M₁ i) with hMdef
   137	  -- the sections to reglue, through the piece trivializations
   138	  have hglue₀ : ∀ i : ι, ∃ f : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i))),
   139	      gluedTriv k hc (σ i) (inf_le_right.trans (hP i)) f =
   140	        X.resHom (inf_le_left.trans hV'V) q ^ M * E i := fun i =>
   141	    ⟨(gluedTriv k hc (σ i) (inf_le_right.trans (hP i))).symm _,
   142	      (gluedTriv k hc (σ i) (inf_le_right.trans (hP i))).apply_symm_apply _⟩
   143	  choose F' hF' using hglue₀
   144	  -- the M-power defect equation, restricted to the gluing overlaps
   145	  have hover : ∀ i i' : ι,
   146	      X.resHom (inf_le_left :
   147	          (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) ≤
   148	            V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i))
   149	        (X.resHom (inf_le_left.trans hV'V) q ^ M * E i) =
   150	      X.resHom (le_inf ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hP i))
   151	            ((inf_le_right.trans inf_le_right).trans (hP i')) :
   152	          (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) ≤
   153	            U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))
   154	          (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))) *
   155	        X.resHom (inf_le_right :
   156	            (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) ≤
   157	              V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i'))
   158	          (X.resHom (inf_le_left.trans hV'V) q ^ M * E i') := by
   159	    intro i i'
   160	    have hMle : M₁ i i' ≤ M :=
   161	      le_trans (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ i'))
   162	        (Finset.le_sup (f := fun l => Finset.univ.sup (M₁ l)) (Finset.mem_univ i))
   163	    have hM' : X.resHom ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left).trans hV'V) q ^ M *
   164	        (X.resHom (inf_le_left :
   165	            V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i') ≤ V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i))
   166	            (E i) -
   167	          X.resHom (le_inf ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hP i))
   168	                (inf_le_right.trans (hP i')))
   169	              (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))) *
   170	            X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right)
   171	              (E i')) = 0 := by
   172	      calc X.resHom ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left).trans hV'V) q ^ M *
   173	            (X.resHom inf_le_left (E i) -
   174	              X.resHom (le_inf ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hP i))
   175	                    (inf_le_right.trans (hP i')))
   176	                  (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))) *
   177	                X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right)
   178	                  (E i'))
   179	          = X.resHom ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left).trans hV'V) q ^ (M - M₁ i i') *
   180	            (X.resHom ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left).trans hV'V) q ^ (M₁ i i') *
   181	              (X.resHom inf_le_left (E i) -
   182	                X.resHom (le_inf ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hP i))
   183	                      (inf_le_right.trans (hP i')))
   184	                    (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))) *
   185	                  X.resHom (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right)
   186	                    (E i'))) := by
   187	            rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hMle]
   188	        _ = 0 := by rw [hM₁ i i', mul_zero]
   189	    have hres := congrArg (X.resHom (le_inf (le_inf
   190	        (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right))
   191	        (inf_le_right.trans inf_le_right) :
   192	      (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) ≤
   193	        V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i'))) hM'
   194	    rw [map_zero, map_mul, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow] at hres
   195	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hres
   196	    rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow]
   197	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   198	    linear_combination hres
   199	  -- reglue over the piece cover of `V'`
   200	  have hcovV' : V' ≤ ⨆ i : ι, V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) := by
   201	    have h1 : V' ≤ V' ⊓ ⨆ i : ι, X.basicOpen (h i) :=
   202	      le_inf le_rfl (hV'V.trans hcov)
   203	    rwa [inf_iSup_eq] at h1
   204	  have hcompat : ∀ i i' : ι,
   205	      gluedRes k U g (inf_le_left :
   206	        (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) ≤
   207	          V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) (F' i) =
   208	      gluedRes k U g (inf_le_right :
   209	        (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) ≤
   210	          V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) (F' i') := by
   211	    intro i i'
   212	    apply (gluedTriv k hc (σ i)
   213	      (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_right.trans (hP i)) :
   214	        (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) ≤ U (σ i))).injective
   215	    have hL : gluedTriv k hc (σ i)
   216	        (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_right.trans (hP i)) :
   217	          (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) ≤ U (σ i))
   218	        (gluedRes k U g (inf_le_left :
   219	          (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) ≤
   220	            V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) (F' i)) =
   221	        X.resHom (inf_le_left :
   222	            (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) ≤
   223	              V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i))
   224	          (X.resHom (inf_le_left.trans hV'V) q ^ M * E i) := by
   225	      rw [gluedTriv_res k hc (σ i) inf_le_left (inf_le_right.trans (hP i)), hF' i]
   226	    have hR : gluedTriv k hc (σ i)
   227	        (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_right.trans (hP i)) :
   228	          (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) ≤ U (σ i))
   229	        (gluedRes k U g (inf_le_right :
   230	          (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) ≤
   231	            V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) (F' i')) =
   232	        X.resHom (le_inf ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hP i))
   233	              ((inf_le_right.trans inf_le_right).trans (hP i')) :
   234	            (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) ≤
   235	              U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))
   236	            (g (σ i) (σ i') : Γ(X, U (σ i) ⊓ U (σ i'))) *
   237	          X.resHom (inf_le_right :
   238	              (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i')) ≤
   239	                V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i'))
   240	            (X.resHom (inf_le_left.trans hV'V) q ^ M * E i') := by
   241	      rw [gluedTriv_eq_unit_mul k hc (σ i) (σ i')
   242	          (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_right.trans (hP i)))
   243	          (inf_le_right.trans (inf_le_right.trans (hP i'))),
   244	        gluedTriv_res k hc (σ i') inf_le_right (inf_le_right.trans (hP i')), hF' i']
   245	    rw [hL, hR]
   246	    exact hover i i'
   247	  obtain ⟨e, he, -⟩ := TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing'
   248	    (X := (X : TopCat)) (C := ModuleCat.{u} k)
   249	    (⟨gluedPresheaf k U g, isSheaf_gluedPresheaf k U g⟩ :
   250	      TopCat.Sheaf (ModuleCat.{u} k) (X : TopCat))
   251	    (fun i => V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) V' (fun i => homOfLE inf_le_left) hcovV' F'
   252	    (fun i i' => hcompat i i')
   253	  refine ⟨N + M, e, ?_⟩
   254	  -- compare over the subordinate piece cover of `V' ⊓ D(q)`
   255	  refine gluedSubmodule_ext k U g σ (fun i => X.basicOpen (h i)) hP
   256	    ((inf_le_left.trans hV'V).trans hcov :
   257	      V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q ≤ ⨆ i : ι, X.basicOpen (h i)) fun i => ?_
   258	  have he'i : gluedRes k U g
   259	      (inf_le_left : V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ≤ V') e = F' i := he i
   260	  -- the `(σ i)`-component of the glue, trivialized
   261	  have htriv := congrArg (gluedTriv k hc (σ i)
   262	    (inf_le_right.trans (hP i) : V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ≤ U (σ i))) he'i
   263	  rw [hF' i] at htriv
   264	  -- restrict the trivialized equation to `(V' ⊓ D(q)) ⊓ D(h i)`
   265	  have hle : (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q) ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ≤ V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) :=
   266	    le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right
   267	  have hres := congrArg (X.resHom hle) htriv
   268	  rw [gluedTriv_apply, gluedRes_coe] at hres
   269	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hres
   270	  rw [map_mul, map_pow] at hres
   271	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hres
   272	  -- the uniformized clear, restricted to the same open
   273	  have hEq := congrArg (X.resHom (le_inf
   274	      (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right)
   275	      (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) :
   276	    (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q) ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ≤
   277	      (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ X.basicOpen q)) (hE i)
   278	  rw [map_mul, map_pow] at hEq
   279	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hEq
   280	  -- assemble
   281	  rw [gluedRes_coe]
   282	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   283	  rw [gluedQsmul_coe, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow]
   284	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   285	  rw [hres, hEq, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, add_comm M N]
   286	
   287	/-- **(P2) defect annihilation for the glued sheaf** on a chart with a trivializing
   288	subordinate basic-open family: a glued section over `V'` restricting to zero on
   289	`V' ⊓ D(q)` is killed by a power of `q`. -/
   290	theorem exists_gluedQsmul_pow_eq_zero
   291	    (hP : ∀ i : ι, X.basicOpen (h i) ≤ U (σ i))
   292	    (hcov : V ≤ ⨆ i : ι, X.basicOpen (h i))
   293	    {V' : X.Opens} (hV' : IsAffineOpen V') (hV'V : V' ≤ V) (q : Γ(X, V))
   294	    (t : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g V'))
   295	    (ht : gluedRes k U g (inf_le_left : V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q ≤ V') t = 0) :
   296	    ∃ M : ℕ, gluedQsmul k U g hV'V (q ^ M) t = 0 := by
   297	  classical
   298	  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite ι
   299	  have hPaff : ∀ i : ι, IsAffineOpen (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) := by
   300	    intro i
   301	    rw [← Scheme.basicOpen_resHom hV'V (h i)]
   302	    exact hV'.basicOpen _
   303	  -- per-piece annihilation of the restricted components
   304	  have hann : ∀ i : ι, ∃ M : ℕ,
   305	      X.resHom (inf_le_left.trans hV'V) q ^ M *
   306	        X.resHom (inf_le_inf_left V' (hP i) :
   307	          V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ≤ V' ⊓ U (σ i)) (t.val (σ i)) = 0 := by
   308	    intro i
   309	    refine (hPaff i).exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_res_eq_zero (inf_le_left.trans hV'V) q
   310	      (X.resHom (inf_le_inf_left V' (hP i)) (t.val (σ i))) ?_
   311	    have hz := congrArg (fun z : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q)) =>
   312	      z.val (σ i)) ht
   313	    simp only [gluedRes_coe, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at hz
   314	    have hz2 := congrArg (X.resHom (le_inf (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
   315	      inf_le_right) ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hP i)) :
   316	        (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ X.basicOpen q ≤
   317	          (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q) ⊓ U (σ i))) hz
   318	    rw [map_zero] at hz2

   324	  refine gluedSubmodule_ext k U g σ (fun i => X.basicOpen (h i)) hP
   325	    (hV'V.trans hcov) fun i => ?_
   326	  have hz : (0 : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g V')).val (σ i) = 0 := rfl
   327	  rw [gluedQsmul_coe, hz, map_zero, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow]

   330	      M₁ i ≤ Finset.univ.sup M₁),

have hle : (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q) ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ≤ V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) :=
    le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right

  rw [gluedTriv_apply, gluedRes_coe] at hres
  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hres

      (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right)
      (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) :
    (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q) ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ≤

/-- **(P2) defect annihilation for the glued sheaf** on a chart with a trivializing
subordinate basic-open family: a glued section over `V'` restricting to zero on
`V' ⊓ D(q)` is killed by a power of `q`. -/
theorem exists_gluedQsmul_pow_eq_zero
    (hP : ∀ i : ι, X.basicOpen (h i) ≤ U (σ i))
    (hcov : V ≤ ⨆ i : ι, X.basicOpen (h i))
    {V' : X.Opens} (hV' : IsAffineOpen V') (hV'V : V' ≤ V) (q : Γ(X, V))
    (t : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g V'))
    (ht : gluedRes k U g (inf_le_left : V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q ≤ V') t = 0) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, gluedQsmul k U g hV'V (q ^ M) t = 0 := by
  classical
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  have hPaff : ∀ i : ι, IsAffineOpen (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) := by
    intro i
    rw [← Scheme.basicOpen_resHom hV'V (h i)]
    exact hV'.basicOpen _
  -- per-piece annihilation of the restricted components
  have hann : ∀ i : ι, ∃ M : ℕ,
      X.resHom (inf_le_left.trans hV'V) q ^ M *
        X.resHom (inf_le_inf_left V' (hP i) :
          V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i) ≤ V' ⊓ U (σ i)) (t.val (σ i)) = 0 := by
    intro i
    refine (hPaff i).exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_res_eq_zero (inf_le_left.trans hV'V) q
      (X.resHom (inf_le_inf_left V' (hP i)) (t.val (σ i))) ?_
    have hz := congrArg (fun z : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q)) =>
      z.val (σ i)) ht
    simp only [gluedRes_coe, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at hz
    have hz2 := congrArg (X.resHom (le_inf (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
      inf_le_right) ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hP i)) :
        (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen (h i)) ⊓ X.basicOpen q ≤
          (V' ⊓ X.basicOpen q) ⊓ U (σ i))) hz
    rw [map_zero] at hz2
    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hz2
    rw [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
    exact hz2
  choose M₁ hM₁ using hann
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.sup M₁, ?_⟩
  refine gluedSubmodule_ext k U g σ (fun i => X.basicOpen (h i)) hP
    (hV'V.trans hcov) fun i => ?_
  have hz : (0 : ↥(gluedSubmodule k U g V')).val (σ i) = 0 := rfl
  rw [gluedQsmul_coe, hz, map_zero, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow]
  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ i) :
      M₁ i ≤ Finset.univ.sup M₁),
    pow_add, mul_assoc, hM₁ i, mul_zero]

/-- **The quasi-coherence packaging of the glued sheaf** on a chart carrying a finite
trivializing subordinate basic-open family (DAT-1 stage 1b): the componentwise (P1)
action together with the two (P2) localization axioms. A `def`: keyed `instance`s are
declared only at the pinned datum (stage 1d), per the house instance discipline. -/
@[reducible] noncomputable def gluedQcohOn (hc : Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U g)
    (hP : ∀ i : ι, X.basicOpen (h i) ≤ U (σ i))
    (hcov : V ≤ ⨆ i : ι, X.basicOpen (h i)) :
    Scheme.QcohOn (gluedSheaf k U g) V where
  qsmul hWV r s := gluedQsmul k U g hWV r s
  one_qsmul hWV s := gluedQsmul_one k U g hWV s
  mul_qsmul hWV r r' s := gluedQsmul_mul k U g hWV r r' s
  add_qsmul hWV r r' s := gluedQsmul_add_left k U g hWV r r' s
  qsmul_add hWV r s t := gluedQsmul_add k U g hWV r s t
  secRes_qsmul hW'W hWV r s := gluedRes_gluedQsmul k U g hW'W hWV r s
  exists_secRes_eq_qsmul_pow hV' hV'V q c :=
    exists_gluedRes_eq_gluedQsmul_pow k U g hc hP hcov hV' hV'V q c
  exists_qsmul_pow_eq_zero hV' hV'V q t ht :=
    exists_gluedQsmul_pow_eq_zero k U g hP hcov hV' hV'V q t ht

end Assembly

events.text: The sibling project already has a clean one-way dialect bridge from `Scheme.Modules` to fixed-base module sheaves, but the rebuild does not. That bridge alone does not package a cocycle datum in the forward direction, so importing it would not close the gate; the honest next contract must explicitly provide the missing `Scheme.Modules` object and identify its fixed-base restriction with `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sheaf`.

1	/-

     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Adelic.GenusUnconditional
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.PullbackQuasicoherent
     9	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.QuotScheme
    10	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.RigidPushforward
    11	
    12	/-!
    13	# Degree-one affine vanishing for quasi-coherent modules and Čech cover-independence
    14	
    15	The wave-5 keystone of the B3 lane: the degree-one affine vanishing
    16	`H¹(U, M) = 0` (`HModule'`-form) for every affine open `U` and every
    17	**quasi-coherent** sheaf of modules `M` on a `Spec k`-scheme, and the resulting
    18	Čech **cover-independence** of `Ȟ¹`-vanishing on 2-affine covers.
    19	
    20	## The bridge
    21	
    22	The `HModule'` derived-functor machinery
    23	(`Cohomology/StructureSheafModuleK/*`, `RiemannRoch/Adelic/GenusUnconditional`)
    24	runs on sheaves of `k`-modules on the opens site; the B3 consumers work with
    25	`X.Modules` (sheaves of `𝒪_X`-modules).  `toModuleKSheafOfModules` is the
    26	dialect bridge: the underlying additive sheaf of `M : C.left.Modules`, with the
    27	`k`-action restricted along the structure morphism (mirroring `toModuleKSheaf`
    28	for the structure sheaf itself).  Sections, restriction maps and hence all
    29	Čech difference maps agree **definitionally** with those of `M`.
    30	
    31	## The vanishing
    32	
    33	`subsingleton_hModule'_one_of_isAffineOpen_of_isQuasicoherent` mirrors the
    34	structure-sheaf proof `subsingleton_hModule'_one_toModuleKSheaf_of_isAffineOpen`
    35	(`AffineDegreeOneVanishing.lean`) step by step; the single 𝒪-specific brick —
    36	sections of the kernel over the basic opens `D(g_σ)` are the localisations
    37	`Γ(M, U)_{g_σ}` — is replaced by the quasi-coherence keystone
    38	`Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_basicOpen` (Stacks 01HV(4)/01I8 at
    39	affine-open generality, `Picard/QuotScheme.lean`), packaged here as the module
    40	section-identification kit `IsAffineOpen.dCoeffModuleSectionsLinearEquiv`
    41	(mirroring `IsAffineOpen.dCoeffSectionsLinearEquiv` of
    42	`CechCoboundarySplitting.lean`).
    43	
    44	## Cover-independence
    45

import Mathlib

/-!
# `ModuleCat k`-valued sheaf cohomology and the structure sheaf as a sheaf of modules

This file provides the cohomology carrier for the genus lane of the Jacobian challenge:

1. For a small site `(C, J)` and a commutative ring `R`, the degree-`n` cohomology
   `Sheaf.HModule F n` of a sheaf `F` of `R`-modules, defined as the `Ext`-group from the
   constant sheaf with value `R` to `F` (mirroring `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H`, which is
   `AddCommGrpCat`-valued; ours is `ModuleCat R`-valued so that `Module.finrank` applies).
   Each `Sheaf.HModule F n` is an `R`-module via the `R`-linear structure of the sheaf
   category, and `Sheaf.HModule.map` gives `R`-linear functoriality in `F`.
2. The degree-zero identification `Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀ : HModule F 0 ≃ₗ[R] F(⊤)`
   via `Ext⁰ ≅ Hom` and the constant-sheaf adjunction, together with its naturality.
3. For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, the structure sheaf of `X` as a sheaf of `k`-modules
   `Scheme.moduleKSheaf` on the small Zariski site `Opens.grothendieckTopology X`, by
   restriction of scalars along the structure morphism, with definitional (`rfl`) access
   to its sections and restriction maps.

## Universe discipline

Everything is single-universe: `k : Type u`, `X : Scheme.{u}`, the site `Opens X : Type u`
with hom-types in `Type u`, and coefficients `ModuleCat.{u} k`. Then
`Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (ModuleCat.{u} k)` is Grothendieck abelian relative
to `u` (`ModuleCat.{u} k` is, and the site is small), hence `HasExt.{u}` holds and
`Sheaf.HModule F n : Type u` with a `Module k` structure — no universe bump anywhere, so
`Module.finrank k` applies directly downstream.

## Design notes

import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.ModulesBaseSheaf
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0EndgameContract
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RingDatumEngine

/-!
# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus

An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
test and ties every piece of data to the input class:

* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.

No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]

/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.

The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
  representative : descentClasses C cover
  represents :
    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
  datum_class :
    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
  module_iso :
    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
  h0_rank_one :
    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1

namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation

variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}

/-- The canonical evaluation map attached to a tied local rank-one presentation. -/
noncomputable def evaluation (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ⟶
      P.module :=
  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module

end PicRankOneLocalPresentation

end AlgebraicGeometry

import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.ModuleKSheaf
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Sheaf

/-!
# Restricting a scheme module to the base ring

For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, this file views an `X.Modules` object as a sheaf of
`k`-modules.  The construction keeps the same section types and restriction maps; only the
scalar action is restricted along `k -> Gamma(X, U)`.  It is the dialect bridge needed to
compare a `Scheme.Modules` line bundle with the fixed-base module sheaves used by the Cech
cohomology engine.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]

/-- The base-ring module structure on sections of a scheme module. -/
@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleKSections
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    (U : X.left.Opens) : Module k Γ(M, U) :=
  Module.compHom _ (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U)

attribute [local instance] moduleKSections

/-- The native structure-sheaf action, with section-notation binders kept explicit. -/
private noncomputable def smulSection
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    (U : X.left.Opens) (r : Γ(X.left, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) : Γ(M, U) :=
  r • x

/-- The presheaf underlying a scheme module after restriction of scalars to the base ring. -/
noncomputable def toModuleKPresheafOfModules
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    X.left.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k where
  obj U := ModuleCat.of k Γ(M, U.unop)
  map {U V} f := ModuleCat.ofHom
    { toFun := fun x => M.presheaf.map f x
      map_add' := fun x y => map_add _ x y
      map_smul' := fun r x =>
        (Scheme.Modules.map_smul M f.unop (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U.unop r) x).trans
          (congrArg
            (fun (s : Γ(X.left, V.unop)) =>
              smulSection X M V.unop s (M.presheaf.map f x))
            (X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k f r)) }
  map_id U := by
    ext x
    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (f : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj U) =>
      (ConcreteCategory.hom f : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_id U)) x
  map_comp {U V W} f g := by
    ext x
    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (h : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj W) =>
      (ConcreteCategory.hom h : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_comp f g)) x

/-- The restricted presheaf is a sheaf because its underlying additive presheaf is unchanged. -/
lemma toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat)
      (toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M) := by
  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _ (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} k))]
  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
      (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).mp (Scheme.Modules.isSheaf M) using 1 <;> rfl

/-- A sheaf of `O_X`-modules, viewed as a sheaf of modules over the base ring. -/
noncomputable def toModuleKSheafOfModules
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat) (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
  ⟨toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M, toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf X M⟩

/-- Restriction maps of the base-ring sheaf are definitionally those of the scheme module. -/
lemma toModuleKSheafOfModules_obj_map_apply
    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (M : X.left.Modules)
    {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V)
    (x : (toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.obj (op V)) :
    ((toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom x =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x :=
  rfl

namespace Modules

variable {X : Scheme.{u}}

/-- A scheme module which is locally isomorphic to the structure sheaf. -/
def IsLineBundle (M : X.Modules) : Prop :=
  ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
    Nonempty ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅ SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)

end Modules

-/-!
-# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
-
-An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
-rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
-map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
-test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
-
-* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
-* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
-* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
-* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
-
-No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
-consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
--/
-
-set_option autoImplicit false
-set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
-
-universe u
-
-open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
-
-namespace AlgebraicGeometry
-
-attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
-attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
-
-variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
-variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
-  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
-variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
-variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
-
-/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.
-
-The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
-witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
-relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
-underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
-structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
-    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
-  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
-  representative : descentClasses C cover
-  represents :
-    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
-  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
-  datum_class :
-    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
-      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
-  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
-  module_iso :
-    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
-      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
-  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
-  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
-  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
-  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
-  h0_rank_one :
-    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
-      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1
-
-namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
-
-variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
-
-/-- The canonical evaluation map attached to a tied local rank-one presentation. -/
-noncomputable def evaluation (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
-    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
-      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj
-        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
-          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ⟶
-      P.module :=
-  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
-    (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module
-
-end PicRankOneLocalPresentation
-
-end AlgebraicGeometry
